integrity: Analytical proof uses polar integration and standard chi-square, beta and gamma identities; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: One unrelaxed Kaczmarz step from zero, independent additive Gaussian perturbations, strictly positive noise scale and row-power sampling; no claim about full-run convergence or stationary moments.
title: Sharp Gaussian-noise moment thresholds for row-power randomized Kaczmarz
